scope: Each Games entry and program (Apps/Programs.js) played by its script in Apps/Games/GamePlays.js on three machines: original TempleOS V5.03 under QEMU (real), the site's HEMU (site) and HolyC-WASM in the Games window (browser). Each runs the script and a control without its input; V5.03 plays it twice. A snap, taken at the start and before each step, is the frame's FNV-1a hash below the status line, its count of colors and a 4-bit digest of each of 16x12 cells; a control keeps the cells that moved without input. verdict, from PlayCmp.mjs, says per machine whether the game stayed alive, drew, advanced and changed with the input (input: cells that do not move without it changed; moved: the frames changed but the game also moves by itself), and where the machines agree. A program (program: true) runs when it returns cleanly before the script or stays alive, draws and advances until its script ends it, and two machines agree on it when they end it the same way.
